pool = pd.read_csv('alloy_pair_target_pool.csv')

num = ['C','Mn','Si','Cr','Ni','Mo','V','Nb','Co','Al','Ti','Cu','Fe','solutionizing_temp','aging_temp','aging_time','cooling_rate']
cat = ['heat_treatment','route']
y = train['target'].values
X = train[num+cat]
Xp = pool[num+cat]

kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

def eval_model(name, model, Xtr):
    pred = cross_val_predict(model, Xtr, y, cv=kf, n_jobs=-1)
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y, pred)
    rmse = mean_squared_error(y, pred)**0.5
    r2 = r2_score(y, pred)
    print(f'{name:20s} MAE={mae:7.2f} RMSE={rmse:7.2f} R2={r2:6.3f} pred_max={pred.max():7.1f} pred_min={pred.min():7.1f}')
    return pred

# numeric only trees
print('=== ExtraTrees numeric ===')
et = ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=400, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
eval_model('ET-num', et, train[num])

print('=== with cats encoded ===')
pre = ColumnTransformer([
    ('num','passthrough', num),
    ('cat', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'), cat)
])

etp = Pipeline([('pre', pre), ('m', ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=500, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, min_samples_leaf=1))])

pred_gbr = eval_model('GBR-oh', gbr, X)

# catboost
cb = CatBoostRegressor(iterations=600, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, loss_function='RMSE', verbose=0, random_seed=42, cat_features=cat)
pred_cb = eval_model('CB', cb, X)

# ridge
ridge = Pipeline([('pre', ColumnTransformer([
    ('num', StandardScaler(), num),
    ('cat', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'), cat)
])), ('m', Ridge(alpha=1.0))])
pred_ridge = eval_model('Ridge', ridge, X)

print('\nensemble of ET+HGB+CB CV')
ens = (pred_et + pred_hgb + pred_cb)/3
print('ENS MAE', mean_absolute_error(y, ens), 'R2', r2_score(y, ens), 'max', ens.max())
